limits: Whitepaper claim, not a blanket deployed-system guarantee. Publisher ABIs expose migrateToSuccessor and HoldingsMigrated for ContractionVault, ExpansionVault and FeeSplitter.

Successor asset migration is not necessarily code replacement; immutable code can coexist with component replacement or asset movement. ABI presence does not establish deployed correspondence, migration authority, callable behavior or current configuration.

An observed administrative SafeProxy and its implementation/MultiSend dependencies do not prove the monetary modules themselves are proxy-upgradeable; current relationships and privileges require fresh checks.
